title: Equal-weight threshold functions
statement: A Boolean function $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ is an equal-weight threshold function if there is a real threshold offset $a_0$ such that, for every input $x$, its value is the sign of $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$, with zero assigned the value $1$.
